title: Review Manager shadow and API evidence
decision: M6 implementation is complete for shadow and HTTP boundary; production review authority remains legacy and the mainnet database was not migrated or written.

implementation.pnlPolicy: Review Manager validates and persists external runArbitrage evidence; it does not calculate or invent PnL.
implementation.broadcastPolicy: Only ok=true, executable=true, complete signed PnL, and strictly positive amount creates request_status=generated; no transaction is sent.
implementation.diagnosticPolicy: SwapNotResolved, revert, quote_failed, rpc_unavailable and evidence_missing remain structured diagnostics and never replace signed PnL.
implementation.idempotencyPolicy: Idempotency-Key plus request digest returns idempotentReplay=true; different digest returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; requestId is not part of the digest.

fixtures: diagnostics do not substitute for signed PnL
positive executable review creates generated broadcast request
zero and non-executable reviews create no broadcast request
dry-run writes no review or idempotency rows
stale closed-loop version is rejected before writes

knownBoundary: Current production authority remains legacy. M6 complete reviews depend on M1-M5 real mainnet shadow bootstrap and cutover; M7 Broadcast Manager is required before any transaction broadcast.
